title: Fixed tensor comparison normalized on flat representatives
statement: For any scheme Z, coefficient ring sheaf RZ, specified derived tensor model a, and flat-term K-flat complex P, there is a natural isomorphism from Q(Tot(P tensor -)) to tensor(QP,Q(-)) whose component at every flat-term K-flat H is the specified representative isomorphism of a. The statement holds for arbitrary unbounded coefficient complexes. Dependencies: [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated], [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property], [lem-weil-pbc-resolving-representative-whiskering], [lem-pc-kflat-resolution].

proof.text: Tensor with P preserves quasi-isomorphisms by the fixed-K-flat tensor theorem. Therefore Q(Tot(P tensor -)) descends through Q by its localization universal property, with comparison phi.

Every complex has a flat-term K-flat resolution. The resolving-representative whiskering theorem implies fully faithful restriction of binary derived functors to pairs of such representatives. Compose the descended functor with the second projection and compare it to tensor(QP,-), also composed with that projection. The given representative isomorphisms, composed with phi, supply an isomorphism after restriction.

Lift this restricted isomorphism by full faithfulness. Restrict its first variable to QP, whisker with Q, and compose with phi inverse. The preimage identity and inverse laws show that its component at each flat H equals exactly the specified representative comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_fixed_tensor_representative_comparison
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (RZ : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel Z RZ)
    (P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Z RZ) ℤ)
    (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Z RZ P) :
    ∃ d : ((Functor.const _).obj P).prod' (𝟭 _) ⋙ (Functor.uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor Z
        RZ).map₂HomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Q ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ ((Functor.const _).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).prod' (𝟭 _) ⋙
        a.tensor,
      ∀ (H : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Z RZ) ℤ)
        (hH : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Z RZ H),
        d.hom.app H = a.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨H, hH⟩)
